findings.claim: Nucor 10-Q 揭露 2026 Q2 最大單一客戶約占銷售 5%，客戶集中度低；搜尋未見任何客戶導入第二供應商或自製的報導。
findings.excerpt: Our largest single customer in the second quarter of 2026 represented approximately 5% of sales and has consistently paid within terms.
